shared_task: 48-node causal arithmetic chain; each node consumes previous verified output; exact independent closed-form oracle
crash_mechanism: Separate worker process exits via os._exit(75); new process resumes same directory
scoring: Correct exact output and digest; fail closed on corrupt data or changed input; no scientific writes
negative_control_ablation: ATOMIC_JSON_PREFIX without intermediate commits equals REPLAY_ALL
repeat_policy: One paired run per scenario/variant; deterministic counts primary; times diagnostic only
frozen_selection_rule: Report Pareto tradeoffs only among zero-critical-error mechanisms. Do not choose full QRCEL or claim general superiority. No quality-cost compensation.
crash_alignment: All variants crash at node 16. After-node means after the persistence step if the variant has one; REPLAY_ALL persists only at full completion and must replay. Before-commit means computed node 16 is not durable.
